summary: x402 relay v1.22.0 doubles sponsor pool to 10 wallets, giving agents 2x concurrent payment capacity
significance: the versioned relay release expands payment throughput before the capacity change is broadly framed as a release signal

changelogEntry: increase sponsor wallet pool from 5 to 10; auto-detect and sponsor transactions with empty sponsor auth; return after broadcast and add GET /settle/status/:txid
proofNote: Primary proof comes from the public version tag, release body, compare view, and linked commits for the relay release.
